title: StoneEra Demo 0.9.15 — Life in the Colony: Resident Control, Wooden Lifts and New Food
author: Arrock12
selftext:
Hey everyone! Here are the main changes in StoneEra Demo 0.9.15 — Life in the Colony.  
This update focuses on everyday colony life: seeing the world through a resident’s eyes, keeping work moving and giving your settlement more ways to build and grow food.  
**Control a Resident**  
Take direct control with WASD and run with Shift, after a safe handoff of their work and cargo.  
Through Eyes lets you follow a resident while they continue their autonomous life. Use R for free look, H to hide the HUD, Esc to return to the colony camera and F12 for clean screenshots.  
**Colony Work and Building**  
Residents arrange missing tools, materials, storage and permitted access before returning to their original task.  
Task List explains blocked work. Allow Access lets residents prepare routes within a marked area, with permissions preserved across saves.  
Urgent Area prioritizes ready work. Clear Area cancels orders and removes placed objects, returning recoverable resources.  
Build wooden passenger lifts spanning 3–18 blocks. One worker operates the winch while another rides with a crate.  
Tall building orders can add temporary lifts and scaffolds, then dismantle them and recover the planks after workers descend.  
Builders reuse whole material crates for nearby blocks, and farmers plant matching plots from a single seed delivery.  
Basic gathering, construction, planting and carpentry can continue by hand at half speed. Ore mining still requires a pickaxe. Early wooden construction and planting are faster.  
Choose from three starter houses or your saved plans. Open Building Editor during gameplay and return to the same world.  
Copy Area keeps your selection after release. Adjust its height with Y/H, copy with Enter or save it as a reusable building plan.  
**Food and Farming**  
Added blueberries, woodland mushrooms, porridge, berry pie, mushroom soup, meat stew and fish stew.  
Mushroom plots mature in six game hours without irrigation. One mushroom yields 1–5 on dry soil or 1–10 with irrigation.  
Fried mushrooms provide twice the food value. Small crates hold 64 raw or fried mushrooms.  
One log cooks up to eight servings of mushrooms, fish, meat or porridge. Four units of flour and one log bake eight loaves. Smaller batches can start with fewer ingredients.  
Ready food gathering, harvesting, hunting, fishing and cooking take priority over other permitted work.  
**World and Wildlife**  
Springs vary with the seasons and respond to water flowing through connected channels.  
Waterfalls resume feeding lower river sections when their water level drops.  
Mature trees attempt to spread saplings every 3–5 game days.  
Wild animals breed and mature more slowly, with local population limits.  
**Interface and Languages**  
Added Japanese, bringing interface support to eight languages.  
Refreshed menus organize Build, Orders, People, Stock, Craft and Research into six HUD buttons.  
Menu backgrounds cycle through eleven gameplay screenshots.  
Build panels leave more room for placement, and the Work table has clearer skill labels and pagination.  
Improved camera rotation on ultrawide screens, mining labels and opening instructions.  
**Fixes and Improvements**  
Improved detours around blocked passages, crowded waypoints and stepped shores.  
Fixed scaffold queues and dismantling situations that could strand workers.  
Fixed residents getting stuck upright when going to sleep, and improved merchant approaches.  
Reduced repeated movement, planning and closed-panel work.  
Corrected hoe animations and builders’ workstation positioning.  
Fixed a terrain texture issue that could cause horizontal stripes on Windows.  
Campfires and lamps retain their physical models during daylight while their flames and embers turn off.  
Building plans and Building Editor are still very early alpha, so bugs and rough edges are expected.  
The Demo has unlimited play time and 12 early technologies through ore smelting, in both Normal and Creative worlds.  
Full announcement on Steam:  
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/5057770/view/683015755528143173  
Thanks for playing! If something goes wrong, your game version, OS, reproduction steps and a screenshot or short clip really help.
